text.tspan: with the rule, in the journal
· never off the mat, never onto a card
Where the robot does not see (sideways, backwards)
· only into cells the sensor saw free
· never into the lane of a rolling ball
· never onto a cell where a ball was seen
in the last 10 s, nor next to one coming closer
· where it does not see: never near one
Limits per mission, if the adults set them
